'''''Imperial Star Destroyer''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It depicted an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] patrolling a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Painting_container.jpg|thumb|left|The container used to store one of the three paintings in ''Galaxies''.]]
The painting ''Imperial Star Destroyer'', alongside the paintings ''KSE Firespray'' and ''X-Wing'', was one of three bonus paintings that was unlockable as a result of players accessing ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' after the "Double Everything Weekend" event on the last days of ''The Empire Strike's Back'' 30th Anniversary Celebration. Accessing ''Galaxies'' after the Double Everything Weekend resulted in a painting container that contained, at random, one of these three paintings.
